# StreamLoots triggers

## Card redeemed

Runs when a viewer plays a StreamLoots card on your stream. This is where the card's fun effect happens.

| Setting | What to put in |
| --- | --- |
| **Card names** | Only run for these cards. Type the card names, separated by commas. Leave empty for any card. |
| **Rarity** | Only run for cards of this rarity. Choose Any to run for every rarity. Options: Any, common, rare, epic, legendary. Starts as: `Any`. |

**Variables you get**

| Variable | What it holds |
| --- | --- |
| `%user%` | Who played the card |
| `%message%` | Their message |
| `%cardName%` | The card's name |
| `%cardDescription%` | What the card does |
| `%cardRarity%` | common, rare, epic or legendary |
| `%isTest%` | True when this is a test event, not a real one |

<small>Type id: `streamloots.cardRedeemed`</small>

## Connected

Runs when Cuebot connects to StreamLoots. Handy for a quick "all good" message or to switch something on.

**Variables you get**

| Variable | What it holds |
| --- | --- |
| `%service%` | The name of the service |

<small>Type id: `streamloots.connected`</small>

## Disconnected

Runs when Cuebot loses or ends its connection to StreamLoots. Handy to warn yourself that alerts have stopped.

**Variables you get**

| Variable | What it holds |
| --- | --- |
| `%service%` | The name of the service |
| `%reason%` | Why the connection ended |

<small>Type id: `streamloots.disconnected`</small>

## Other alert (e.g. reactions)

Runs for other StreamLoots alerts that are not purchases, gifts or cards, such as reactions.

| Setting | What to put in |
| --- | --- |
| **Alert types** | Only run for these kinds of alert, named as StreamLoots names them, separated by commas. Leave empty for any. |

**Variables you get**

| Variable | What it holds |
| --- | --- |
| `%user%` | Who did it |
| `%alertType%` | The kind of alert |
| `%alertMessage%` | The alert text |
| `%message%` | Their message |
| `%isTest%` | True when this is a test event, not a real one |

<small>Type id: `streamloots.alert`</small>

## Pack gifted

Runs when someone gifts StreamLoots chests, to one viewer or to the whole community.

| Setting | What to put in |
| --- | --- |
| **Minimum chests** | Only run when at least this many chests were gifted at once. 1 means any gift. Starts as: `1`. |
| **Include community gifts (random viewers)** | Tick to also run when chests are gifted to random viewers. Untick to run only for gifts to one named person. Starts as: `true`. |

**Variables you get**

| Variable | What it holds |
| --- | --- |
| `%user%` | Who did it |
| `%message%` | Their message |
| `%quantity%` | How many chests |
| `%isTest%` | True when this is a test event, not a real one |
| `%giftee%` | Who got the gift (empty for a community gift) |
| `%communityGift%` | True if it went to random viewers |

<small>Type id: `streamloots.packGifted`</small>

## Pack purchased

Runs when a viewer buys chests (card packs) on StreamLoots. Great for a thank-you.

| Setting | What to put in |
| --- | --- |
| **Minimum chests** | Only run when at least this many chests were bought at once. 1 means any purchase. Starts as: `1`. |

**Variables you get**

| Variable | What it holds |
| --- | --- |
| `%user%` | Who did it |
| `%message%` | Their message |
| `%quantity%` | How many chests |
| `%isTest%` | True when this is a test event, not a real one |

<small>Type id: `streamloots.packPurchased`</small>
